general.question: What is Toolzary?
general.answer: Toolzary is a completely free online platform offering professional tools including calculators, converters, and utilities. All tools work directly in your browser with no sign-up required.

general.question: Is Toolzary really free?
general.answer: Yes! Toolzary is 100% free forever. No hidden charges, no premium plans, and no credit card required.

general.question: Do I need to create an account?
general.answer: No sign-up or registration is required. Simply visit our website and start using any tool instantly.

general.question: Who is Toolzary for?
general.answer: Toolzary is for students, developers, teachers, finance professionals, designers, and anyone who needs quick and reliable online tools.

privacy.question: Are my calculations private?
privacy.answer: Yes. All calculations and processing happen directly in your browser. We never see, store, or share your data.

privacy.question: Is my data stored anywhere?
privacy.answer: No. Your data stays in your browser only. We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal information.

privacy.question: Does Toolzary use cookies?
privacy.answer: We only use minimal cookies for essential preferences like theme (light/dark mode).

account.question: Do I need to register to use Toolzary?
account.answer: No registration is required. All tools are available instantly without creating an account.

account.question: Can I save my calculations?
account.answer: Some tools store history locally in your browser for convenience, but nothing is saved on our servers.

account.question: Will Toolzary ever require login?
account.answer: No. Toolzary will always remain free and accessible without registration.

technical.question: What browsers are supported?
technical.answer: Toolzary works on all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and Opera.

technical.question: Does Toolzary work offline?
technical.answer: Most tools work after loading once, but initial access requires an internet connection.

technical.question: Is there a mobile app?
technical.answer: Toolzary is currently web-based but fully responsive. A mobile app is planned for the future.

technical.question: How do I report a bug?
technical.answer: You can report issues via the Contact page using the 'Report a Bug' option.

faqs.question: How does the age calculator work?
faqs.answer: It calculates the exact difference between your birth date and today's date in years, months, and days.

faqs.question: What date format should I use?
faqs.answer: Use YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 1990-05-15.

faqs.question: Does it account for leap years?
faqs.answer: Yes. It automatically handles leap years and different month lengths for accurate results.

faqs.question: How is attendance percentage calculated?
faqs.answer: Attendance percentage = (Classes Attended ÷ Total Classes) × 100.

faqs.question: What is minimum required attendance?
faqs.answer: Most institutions require 75% attendance, but it may vary.

faqs.question: What does 'Classes Needed' mean?
faqs.answer: It shows how many more classes you must attend to reach your target percentage.

faqs.question: What is average (mean)?
faqs.answer: Average is the sum of all numbers divided by the total count of numbers.

faqs.question: What is median?
faqs.answer: Median is the middle value when numbers are sorted.

faqs.question: What is BMI?
faqs.answer: BMI (Body Mass Index) estimates body fat using height and weight.

faqs.question: How is BMI calculated?
faqs.answer: BMI = weight (kg) ÷ height² (m²).

faqs.question: What are BMI categories?
faqs.answer: Underweight: <18.5, Normal: 18.5–24.9, Overweight: 25–29.9, Obese: 30+

faqs.question: What is Title Case?
faqs.answer: Title Case capitalizes major words in a sentence.

faqs.question: What is Sentence Case?
faqs.answer: Sentence Case capitalizes only the first letter of a sentence.

faqs.question: Does it preserve formatting?
faqs.answer: Yes. Spaces, punctuation, and symbols remain unchanged.

faqs.question: What characters are counted?
faqs.answer: All letters, numbers, spaces, punctuation, symbols, emojis, and line breaks are counted.

faqs.question: Does it count emojis?
faqs.answer: Yes. Emojis and special characters are included in the count.

faqs.question: Is sentence splitting accurate?
faqs.answer: Yes. It handles abbreviations and decimals to avoid incorrect splits.

faqs.question: What is code minification?
faqs.answer: It removes unnecessary spaces, comments, and formatting to reduce file size.

faqs.question: Which languages are supported?
faqs.answer: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, XML, and SQL.

faqs.question: Is my code stored?
faqs.answer: No. All processing happens locally in your browser.

faqs.question: What is HEX color?
faqs.answer: HEX is a 6-digit code representing colors, like #4F46E5.

faqs.question: What is RGB?
faqs.answer: RGB uses Red, Green, Blue values from 0 to 255.

faqs.question: What is HSL?
faqs.answer: HSL stands for Hue, Saturation, and Lightness.

faqs.question: How do I calculate discount?
faqs.answer: Discount = (Percentage × Original Price) ÷ 100.

faqs.question: Difference between percentage and amount off?
faqs.answer: Percentage off is relative, while amount off is a fixed reduction.

faqs.question: How does exam countdown work?
faqs.answer: It calculates time remaining until your exam in real-time.

faqs.question: What happens at zero?
faqs.answer: It shows a celebration message when the countdown ends.

faqs.question: What is GPA?
faqs.answer: GPA is the average of your grades on a standard scale (usually 4.0).

faqs.question: How is GPA calculated?
faqs.answer: GPA = total grade points ÷ total credit hours.

faqs.question: What is JSON?
faqs.answer: JSON is a lightweight data format used for storing and exchanging data.

faqs.question: What does validation do?
faqs.answer: It checks if your JSON syntax is correct.

faqs.question: Is my data stored?
faqs.answer: No. All processing happens locally in your browser.

faqs.question: What is Lorem Ipsum?
faqs.answer: Placeholder text used in design and publishing.

faqs.question: What formats are available?
faqs.answer: Plain text, HTML, and Markdown.

faqs.question: How do I calculate percentage?
faqs.answer: Percentage = (Part ÷ Whole) × 100.

faqs.question: What is percentage change?
faqs.answer: ((Final - Initial) ÷ Initial) × 100.

faqs.question: How does it work?
faqs.answer: It generates pseudo-random numbers using JavaScript Math.random() within your range.

faqs.question: Can numbers repeat?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each number is independently generated.

faqs.question: Can I generate decimals?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can choose decimal precision up to 15 places.

faqs.question: How does sentence counting work?
faqs.answer: It detects sentence endings using ., !, and ?, while handling abbreviations and decimals.

faqs.question: What is average words per sentence?
faqs.answer: It shows how many words are in each sentence on average.

faqs.question: What do sentence breakdown numbers show?
faqs.answer: They show the word count of each individual sentence.

faqs.question: How does word counting work?
faqs.answer: It detects words using whitespace and punctuation rules while handling emojis and Unicode text.

faqs.question: What is unique words?
faqs.answer: Unique words count distinct words ignoring duplicates and case differences.

faqs.question: How is reading time calculated?
faqs.answer: Reading time is estimated at 200 words per minute.
